style: Nilachala style (hybrid Nagara beehive dome and medieval Assamese roof)
key_structures: Garbhagriha (subterranean cave shrine with natural spring)
Natamandira (pillared dance hall with apsidal end)
special_features: Natural subterranean spring flowing over yoni-shaped rock fracture
Beehive shikhara with sculptured stone bands
Sunken inner sanctum accessed by steep rock-cut steps
Sculpted relief panels of Ganesha, Mahishasuramardini, and Chamunda on outer walls
renovation_history: Original temple destroyed during invasions; rebuilt by Koch King Chilarai and King Naranarayana in 1565 CE in Nilachala architectural style; expanded by Ahom kings in 17th-18th centuries.
